programme.title: Indian Summer
programme.desc: Alle vrouwen in het leven van Dominique en Tom krijgen een stoer menu voorgeschoteld: een Paloma cocktail, geflambeerde schelpjes, asado van speenvarken én Espresso Martini. De avond eindigt verrassend nog met een rondje paaldansen.

programme.title: De Garde van Gert
programme.desc: Gert Verhulst staat vandaag achter het fornuis met chef Olivier de Vinck. Olivier toont hoe je creatief kan zijn met bloemkool. Hij prepareert de groente op verschillende manieren. Een gebakken stuk zeetong maakt de maaltijd compleet. Njam!

programme.title: KLAAR IN 20 minuten
programme.desc: Vandaag kookt de chef die Arabisch, hip en verrassend mixt in 1 enthousiaste zwier: Toub Mounir! Hij vult Turks brood op met tuinbonen en feta en bakt hem krokant onder de grill. Er is zelfs nog tijd voor een zelfgemaakte tahinimayonaise!

programme.title: Vlaamse Klassiekers
programme.desc: Stoofvlees en kabeljauwhaasje - Wie Vlaamse klassiekers zegt, zegt stoofvlees met frietjes. Lynn leert vandaag de kneepjes van het oervlaamse stoofpotje bij Mémé Gusta in Gent. Daarna bezoekt ze brasserie De Zwaan in Hasselt voor haar favoriete stuk vis: kabeljauwhaasje.

programme.title: Foodies & The City
programme.desc: Lynn, Tess en Maud gaan op zoek naar de culinaire hotspots in Antwerpen. Op het menu: een rock 'n roll beenhouwer, een stokoud, geel drankje en een waar deco paradijs. Inspiratie genoeg voor de meiden om daarna zelf aan de slag te gaan.

programme.title: De Zomertafel
programme.desc: Aflevering 2 - Dagny Ros & Peppe maken zomerse gerechten. Dagny Ros: Blini's met gerookte zalm en mierikswortel // Gevulde Kipfiletrolletjes // Pastasalade à la Dagny Ros. Peppe: Focaccia op de BBQ // Veggie pasta met een saus van mascarpone en erwtjes // Salade van calamares, octopus & vongole.

programme.title: Vlaanderen kookt
programme.desc: Vlamingen zijn Bourgondiërs. Ze weten dat eten een warm en sociaal gebeuren is.Elk gezin heeft wel een speciaal gerecht waar het trots op is. Een specialiteit die ze maar al te graag delen met vrienden en kennissen. Een recept dat een plaats verdient in een kookboek.

programme.title: KLAAR IN 20 minuten
programme.desc: Vandaag kookt de chef die graag de wolligste woordspelletjes hakt in de pan: Jelle Beeckman! Hij gaat voor India in het bord en maakt een kikkererwtencurry met nectarine. Het lukt hem ook een flatbread te maken, allemaal binnen de tijd.

programme.title: De Garde van Gert
programme.desc: Gert Verhulst staat vandaag achter het fornuis met chef Jan Tournier. Ze vieren een halfuur kookplezier met een lekker gerecht van gerookte paling met couscous. Een echte smaakbom, in De Garde van Gert!

programme.title: Op de Rooster
programme.desc: Johan Segers ontvangt bekende Vlamingen die samen met hem de geneugten van het barbecueën beleven.In deze aflevering bereidt hij samen met Tom Waes oa kalfsniertjes, kalfslever, kalfshersenen, kalfsmergpijpjes en kalfsonglet.

programme.title: Meat Timon
programme.desc: Vandaag gaat Timon voor old school vlees dat helemaal weer in is: varkenswangen. Die tovert hij om tot heerlijke pulled pork taco's. Daarna serveert hij pinsa met Arabische toppings zoals spicy lamsgehakt, frisse yoghurt en groene kruiden.

programme.title: Foodies & The City
programme.desc: Lynn, Tess en Maud gaan op zoek naar de culinaire hotspots in Antwerpen. Op het menu: een rock 'n roll beenhouwer, een stokoud, geel drankje en een waar deco paradijs. Inspiratie genoeg voor de meiden om daarna zelf aan de slag te gaan.

programme.title: Becoming Meewis
programme.desc: Vader Bert Meewis kiest voor een klassieke bereiding van duif met een heerlijke saus, terwijl zoon Giel Meewis verrast met een gedurfde interpretatie: een krokant eitje van duif met de saus van zijn vader én rood gekleurde zilveruitjes.

programme.title: Meat Timon
programme.desc: Vandaag gaat Timon voor old school vlees dat helemaal weer in is: varkenswangen. Die tovert hij om tot heerlijke pulled pork taco's. Daarna serveert hij pinsa met Arabische toppings zoals spicy lamsgehakt, frisse yoghurt en groene kruiden.

programme.title: Winterse Kost
programme.desc: De ultieme Winterse Kost van Wim is een ovenschotel Parmentier, maar dan net iets anders. Daarna gaat ook z'n winterse traybake en z'n Orloffgebraad de oven in. En dan is er nog dessert: homemade vanillepudding met speculaas!

programme.title: De Zomertafel
programme.desc: Aflevering 1 - Bart Desmidt en Jeroen De Pauw maken zomerse gerechten: Bart: Salade van geitenkaas, perzik, granola, Parmaham en basilicum // Licht gerookte zeebaars met rabarber, yoghurt en boontjes // Gepaneerde kalfskotelet. Jeroen: Gegrilde groenten op de BBQ // Varkensribstuk op de BBQ // Kruidenbrood.

programme.title: Op Hete Kolen
programme.desc: Vandaag komt er familie op bezoek bij onze barbecue chef: zijn broer en zus komen langs met hun partners en met het kleine neefje en nichtje van Michaël. Onze hippe chef kiest vandaag voor een op en top zomers barbecue gerecht: geroosterd buikspek met verse guacamole. Hierbij serveert hij nog een fris slaatje met rucola én leert hij ons een truc om je mayonaise een echte barbecue rooksmaak te geven. Als top of the bill flanst hij ook nog een geroosterde bruschetta met kip en aubergine in elkaar en maakt hij ook nog een gevulde worst voor de kindjes. Alvast één ding staat vast: er is genoeg voor iedereen!

programme.title: De Dagschotel
programme.desc: In ‘De Dagschotel’ maakt één van de njam-chefs een eenvoudig en lekker gerecht klaar dat de kijker thuis gemakkelijk kan namaken.

programme.title: Chris Cooks Cymru
programme.desc: Caernarfon - In zijn geboortestad Caernarfon duikt chef Chris "Flamebaster" in de rijke culinaire tradities van Noord-Wales. Hij ontdekt de vergeten oestercultuur van de Menai Strait, kookt een klassieke Victoriaanse beef & oyster pie, en serveert sappige brisket buns aan de band Doniau Cudd. Ook bezoekt hij een duurzame paddenstoelenboerderij en proeft hij fine dining bij restaurant Sheeps and Leeks. De aflevering eindigt met een visfeest op zijn oude woonwijk, met vers gevangen makreel van lokale vissers.

programme.title: Becoming Meewis
programme.desc: Vader Bert Meewis kiest voor een klassieke bereiding van duif met een heerlijke saus, terwijl zoon Giel Meewis verrast met een gedurfde interpretatie: een krokant eitje van duif met de saus van zijn vader én rood gekleurde zilveruitjes.

programme.title: Meesterlijke Klassiekers
programme.desc: Stoverij (deel 1) - Sterrenchef Peter Goossens doet de grootste klassiekers uit onze keuken alle eer aan doen: van stoofvlees tot waterzooi, van kaaskroketten tot vol-au-vent, en toon hoe je deze gerechten op z'n best op tafel tovert.

Vervolgens ontmoet ze een man (Chris Evans) waarmee ze in de loop van de nacht een onwaarschijnlijke band opbouwt.

programme.title: Little Manhattan
programme.desc: Gabe en Rosemary kennen elkaar al bijna hun hele leven, maar als zij op karateles tegenover elkaar komen te staan, zien zij elkaar in een geheel ander daglicht.

programme.title: Laughing Out Loud (LOL)
programme.desc: LOL staat voor Laughing Out Loud én is de bijnaam van de 16-jarige scholiere Lola. Zij en haar vrienden lachen heel wat af in een wereld verbonden door YouTube, iTunes en Facebook. programme.desc: Samantha Mackenzie kan niet wachten om het ouderlijk huis te verlaten en op zichzelf te gaan wonen als ze gaat studeren aan de universiteit. Toch zal het voor Samantha niet gemakkelijk worden, omdat haar vader de president van de Verenigde Staten is en ze momenteel in het Witte Huis woont.

programme.desc: At the village of Puckaun in north Tipperary, teachers Darragh Egan, his partner Sarah Lovett and their three month old son Donagh are moving home. programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Airline pilot Ian Callaghan has bought a 1930s Victorian house in his hometown of Drogheda, County Louth, which he and his girlfriend Claire Moore are keen to call home. Though full of charm and period features, the house is in dire need of renovation. Enter: architect Dermot Bannon with an innovative plan to retain the building's century-old ambience while adding a radical modern extension.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Last year, Aoife from Sutton and her wife Mel from New Zealand bought themselves a three bed semi in Baldoyle north Dublin - a tiny house in a spectacular bayside location. With incredible, unobstructed views of the sea and Portmarnock golf course, they've been hoping to renovate the house to suit its superb location ever since.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: This week Dermot is in Maynooth. Seven years ago, George and Sinead Mullis fell in love in with the Coach house - an 1850s building on half an acre of the historic former Carton Estate in Maynooth. In 2014, they bought the place for just half of its former asking price and moved in with their two year old son Daniel. But what seemed like their dream home soon turned out to be anything but.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: A special edition of the show where Dermot revisits three of his favourite builds from earlier series: the Longford publicans he convinced the embrace the void, a couple moving home from California to Bishopstown and 14 year old Michael's wheelchair accessible semi-d in Malahide.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Robbie and Julie from Darndale in North Dublin have saved for over 20 years to buy the house of their dreams - a 1940s cottage in the picturesque north Dublin suburb of Malahide. With a budget of 180K, Dermot's clients plan to gut the cottage, doubling its size with a spacious new two-storey extension to the rear, but the remediation costs are high.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Farmer and Boatbuilder Enda and his wife Mags live on a 55 acre Brussel Sprout farm at Balheary near Swords in North Dublin. After three decades of life in the country, they're moving back to Enda's home town - the picturesque seaside village of Rush. Their new home, formerly owned by Enda's aunt is an old fisherman's house near the harbour.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Moate in County Westmeath, is a place where football is part sport, part religion. On an overgrown plot on the outskirts of town lies the abandoned future home of county GAA All Star Dessie Dolan, his wife Kelly and their 3-year-old son Nathan. They have bought themselves a dilapidated cottage on a hopelessly exposed site in the village.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: At Sutton in North Dublin, Dermot extends a 1960s suburban house, changing a beloved childhood home into a sumptuous new one for Hannah, James and their twin sons. To give the couple the 'wow factor' they've asked for, Dermot designs a large L-shaped extension at the rear of the house with a soaring mezzanine level.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Having rented a house in Navan for the last two years, teacher Celine and sound engineer Dave are excited at the prospect of moving to a farmhouse once owned by her grandparents at Kildalkey village in County Meath where Celine grew up. The couple will be the fourth generation to live there and retaining the charm and character of the old place is a major concern for the whole family.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: In the three years since newlyweds Rosie and Keith bought their five-bed house in Templeogue, Dublin 6, they haven't changed a thing. From the dark, cold interiors to the cavity block, flat roofed extension, this house is a relic of 1970s design, with décor to match. Keen to create a unique take on the rather unimaginative suburban semi, Dermot designs a radical, steep-roofed extension...

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Country and Irish legend Daniel O'Donnell and his wife Majella share a large four bed detached home in Kincasslagh West Donegal. Unlike Daniel, who's fairly happy with the place, Majella is keen to upgrade and reconfigure the interior. With her husband on tour, she's determined to get the very best from her architect.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Nine years ago, Susie and Dave bought their dream home on the outskirts of Fermoy in Cork - a 170 year old three storey mansion that Susie has admired since she was a teenager. The house however, has begun to show its age and Susie and Dave want to extend and upgrade to create the ultimate family home.

And despite his best efforts, Dermot is unable to convince Christine to modify her 25 page wish list.

programme.title: Room to Improve

programme.title: Room to Improve

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Dairy farmer Padraig and schoolteacher Katie are hoping to create their 'forever' home by renovating a century-old farmhouse on a half acre of land recently inherited from Padraig's uncle. Joe's house is a 3 bedroom, 2 storey house on a half acre site about half a mile from Borrisoleigh, with beautiful views of green fields. Mary and Joe are creating their dream home, to move into just after their wedding. Joe has lived the bachelor life up until now and his house reflects this. programme.title: Room to Improve

programme.desc: Claudia and Tom bought this 1920s bungalow with panoramic views of Tramore Bay in 2012 for 305K. Just back from living abroad (Spain, Dubai and Germany) they have been living in the house for the past year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E06 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 6, Joensuu Part 1
programme.desc: In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They’re going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other’s strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let’s find out!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E07 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 7, Joensuu Part 2
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland- Joensuu. Welcome to the final day of the world’s strongest team event. The race to be the best team in the world is coming to its crowing point. All is still wide open for any of these to take the title. Who is going to win? Will team Latvia keep their World Title or maybe Finland can attach them? Keep watching and we’ll find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E08 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 8, Esposende
programme.desc: Welcome back to Strongman Champions League for another stage of the 2022 world tour. We’re in Esposende - Portugal in this beautiful setting next to the beach in front of a packed crowd with some of the strongest men the world has to offer. With a real Porsche deadlift and many other crazy stuff. So, lets get this show started.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E09 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 9, Great Britain
programme.desc: Hello and welcome in Gloucester, UK. The world tour hasn’t been here for what feels like forever. And now for the first time in the Mekka of Strongman, the SCL World series will crown a great Champion with the SCL Title. It will be full with special wooden events, and a great winner! So ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, brace yourselves because I present to you strongman champions league UK.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E10 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 10, Poland Part 1
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland the home of Legends Mariusz Pudzianowkski and Krzystof Radzikowski. Who will grab the title here in holiday resort Sopot, on the great Balrtic Sea with 6 events and 12 athlets in the mix!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E11 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 11, Poland Part 2
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland, after 3 events the Polish Strongman Oskar Ziolkowski is Leading. Kelvin, Travis and Aivars are coming up and will try to beat him, but will Oskar take his first title ever?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E12 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 12, Bosnia
programme.desc: it’s been a long time since the world series held a championship here in Sarajevo. Let’s see what test of strength this destination holds for our athletes. And what fantastic athletes are here again in Stage 12 of the SCL World Series. The strongman champions league Bosnia is another iconic Strongman event with the return of Rongo Keen from Australia and Portugal winner 2022 George Sulaiman.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E13 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 13, Romania
programme.desc: Welcome to Sibiu in Romania. It’s an important day for some of these athletes, because four of them have a real chance of getting into our all-exclusive world finals. There’s only one more stage after this to get those all-important extra points. So, there’s going to be some fireworks, who will take the title here and who will qualify for the World Finals?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E14 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 14, Gibraltar
programme.desc: This is it the last show before the world final. These guys have really got to fight for the points now, this is going to be action packed, whilst these guys fight it out all day.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E15 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 15, Turkey Part 1
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkey’s south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season of Strongman Champions League. Here in the sunshine, we’ll finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is. You could not ask for a better setting. After months of hard-work, if not years for some of these lads, we find out who will take the world title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E16 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 16, Turkey Part 1
programme.desc: Welcome, to day two of the strongman champions league 2022 finals here in Alanya, Turkey. It’s all up for grabs now, everyone is fighting for the world title belt. This is an epic episode where we finally crown the World champion of 2022.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E01 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 1 - Finland
programme.desc: Welcome to the 2023 Strongman Champions League in Vaasa, Finland! This year’s event introduces a knockout format with 6 intense events over 90 minutes, ending in a unique deadlift face-off with boats.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E02 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 2 - Serbia
programme.desc: Stage 2 of the Strongman Champions League 2023 is set in Zrenjanin, Serbia. This exciting event features 5 challenging contests, including a superhuman Yoke race. As the SCL World Series Tour continues, athletes will battle it out to claim the yellow leader’s position for the season. Don’t miss this incredible stage of strength and endurance!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E03 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 3 - Finland Teams World
programme.desc: The World’s Strongest Team will be crowned in this edition of SCL, here in Kalajoki-Finland we’ve picked some of the best in the business, teamed them up, and they’ll be going all out against each other. It’s now no longer about being a lonely wolf, but more about the pack mentality. It is a competition over 7 events, including a Big 2-man Log lift and heavy deadlift. Let’s start the action.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E04 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 4 - Holland
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League in Holland at the Dru Factory in ULFT. A great location for a spectacular battle with 14 Athletes over 3 events! The first 3 events in this episode are Truckpull/ Superyoke and Farmerswalk, with 2 massive logs of 150 kg in their hands. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it’s the circus of the extreme.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E05 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 5 - Holland 2023
programme.desc: Ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, strongman fans across the world, we are back for SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it’s about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland, continues with the last 3 events, here at the Dru Factory in ULFT. The events in this episode are the Viking Press, Wheel Flip and the Atlas Stones, with 180 kg in the end.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E06 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 6 - World's Strongest Latino
programme.desc: For the first time ever, the World’s Strongest Latino competition has begun. This two-day event in Porto, Portugal, features 20 athletes from around the world competing in 8 events. After 4 grueling events, the top 12 will advance to the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E07 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 7 - Finland World Record Breakers
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League World Record Breakers 2023 starts with a 25-ton snow plow! Crazy machines are pulled and pushed, with many kilograms moved. A few new world records are set in this competition.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E08 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 8 - Portugal
programme.desc: We have returned to the powerhouse of Portugal for an edge-of-your-seat galactic battle. If all the planets collided at once, it wouldn’t compare to the bang of this show. Get ready for the battle of the beasts; it’s the heaviest show in the universe, the Strongman Champions League.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E09 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 9 - England
programme.desc: SCL UK has landed in Gloucester it is workout war fitness for the ferocious, it’s going to be a a battle of the brutal, a rampage of the roofless. This is going to be a massacre of the muscles. You know it by now, but just in case you don’t, this is strongman champions league.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E10 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 10 - World's Strongest Viking
programme.desc: On the menu this week it’s medieval madness, we’ve come back to the middle ages to test our noble men through a muscle gaining of events. They are hoping and we are hoping that one will survive to take the title of the world’s strongest Viking. The official World's Strongest Viking is this time in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This week is a good one, can you feel the energy? Sit still, just look at me and try and feel the energy, because I can tell you, the atmosphere here is electric, it’s explosive, there is a pure elemental force going through these athletes' veins. I’m shaking because it’s Poland, it’s powerful, it’s strongman champions league, and you know what I'm going to say, get ready because it’s about to get heavy.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Poland part 2 - Who will win the title in Poland and take 25 points for the world ranking. It is very exciting on the top, in part 1 between Poland and Latvia. Another great episode with super strongman events such as: Bag Toss Medley, Log Lift Reps and the Powerstairs. Also an interview with Mateusz Kieloszkowski, the all time favorite champion from Poland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: It’s time to show our strength and gain respect from the gods of Olympus. Our gladiators have many events set out by no other than Hercules himself. The coliseum is ready here on this mythological island of Cyprus, so we have landed in Limassol were again 12 Top Strongmen are battling for the title and ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E14 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 14 - South Africa
programme.desc: The only and official world championship Truckpulling for its 10th year, again at the Strongman Champions league. With the 3 times Worldchampion Kelvin de Ruiter – defending his title. This championship has trucks in all shapes and sizes which is a lot like our athletes, there all different pay loads, but does the biggest win or is it the strongest.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E15 Stage 15 - SCL World Finals Bosnia
programme.desc: Years and years of determination has brought us here today, when all the walls felt like they were caving in perseverance. When their bodies were screaming, hurting, shouting stop, beneath. These are the things which make up a man, these are the things that bring you world finalists. This episode they fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E16 Stage 16 - SCL World Finals Bosnia
programme.desc: Part 2 of the World Finals of the Strongman Champions League tour 2023 at the Sarajevo Centar Skenderija in Bosnia. 3 Events was done already and amazing results have been set. Who will be the new World champion? Find out here, who, after 16 stages, will be crowned World Champion 2023.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After 10 years there is another edition of THE ICEMAN in minus 25 degrees and snow, and it is also the first stage in the MLO Strongman Champions League. With a new World champion from South Africa, Rayno Nel, it will be a challenging year for all the athletes to win the title again after 1 full year. But now they can win one very exceptional title, which is the SCL ICEMAN!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A battle in the beautiful Caribbean Islands. Over 2 days and more than 10,000 spectators expected like previous editions. The cold temperature from the Iceman is changed in 35 degrees hot Martinique. Watch who gets the title in Martinique, events include: Truck Pull, Deadlift, Hercules Hold, Log Lift, and Arm Over Arm Pull.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The SCL Hungary this year is in the AQUAPARK in Budapest, Stage 3 from the spectacular MLO Strongman Champions League, World is Biggest Pro League. With five great events, such as: Viking Press, Farmer's Walk, Deadlift, Conan's Wheel, and A loading race with Beer barrels of 200 Kg. It is a must see!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We're in Zrenjanin, Serbia, again a fantastic stage in the SCL WORLD SERIES TOUR 2024, five events including a super human Yoke race. Who will be the yellow leader for the coming season and take the title with 25 championship points?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We're in Groenlo, east of Holland With the new Talent from South Africa and 2025 Strongest Man of the World - Rayno Nel. The first 3 events are Truckpull, Log Lift and Loading race. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it is the circus of the extreme.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it is about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland , continues with the last 3 events, here at the venue in Groenlo. The events in this episode are the Conan Wheel, Farmers Walk and the Atlas Stones, with a brutal 200kg stone at the end.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S10 : E07 Stage 7 - FINLAND - 2024 - World record breakers
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League: World Record Breakers 2024 kicks off with the Truck Pull, followed by the Front Hold, Frame Carry, Tractor Pull, Shield Carry, Sandbag Toss, and concludes with the intense Loading Race. This two-day competition features all the top strongmen from Finland-and it's one for the history books. Three new world records are shattered, making this a must-see episode for...

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the first time in over 10 years back in Estonia, in Tartu. 12 of the Strongest athletes in the world will fight here for the title and the overall world championship points. You will see 5 crazy events, such as: Boat Pull, Viking Press, Medley, Conan's Wheel and a very heavy Power Stairs!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We have returned to Portugal, at the beach of Eposende, to bring you EUROPE'S STRONGEST LATINO. In the beautiful sun of Portugal five cruel events are done in this heat: Truck Pull, Deadlift, Log Lift, Sandbag Toss, Medley.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A spectacular event on the beach of Gdansk, Poland. A competition in the sand and in the water. Complete with a boat pull. With an impressive line up again, we welcome you to watch us LIVE in the SCL Poland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League Train stops in Dubai again for the 3rd time, and is now bigger than ever. Hafthor Bjornsson makes his come back here at the SCL DUBAI. You simply cannot miss this most epic show at the World Trade Center in Dubai part 1.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After three cruel events in part 1, the World record holder on the deadlift with 501 Kg, will fight for the crown and the title. You simply cant miss this most epic show, at in the World Trade Center in Dubai part 2.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Superhumans arrive in Limassol. Great strongmen from all over the world will compete in the Old Port of Limassol , for the title and championship points. More than ever important this stage, as we come so close to the World Finals in Turkey this year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With 12 of the world's best athletes arriving in Cape Town, South Africa, all fighting for the crown and final ranking points ahead of the World Finals in Turkey. Rayno Nel still needs to qualify along with Brian Kichton also battling for a seat in the World Finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S10 : E15 Stage 15 - TURKEY - WORLD FINALS - 2024 - PART 1
programme.desc: This episode contestants fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever. Twelve finalists from all over the world are in Turkey and will fight for the ultimate title: WORLD CHAMPION 2024.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S10 : E16 Stage 16 - TURKEY - WORLD FINALS - 2024 - PART 2
programme.desc: Part 2 of the world final of the Strongman Champions League tour 2024 in Alanya, Turkey. With three Events down and amazing results. Who will be the new World champion?

programme.sub-title: S01 : E16 SCL 2014 Season 1, Episode 16, Malaysia (World Finals Part 2)

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E01 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 1, Norway
programme.desc: Across seven rivers, through mountains and forests, 12 strongmen go to toughest places to find out who is strongest Viking in the World and open a new season of Strongman champions league for 2015. Events like the Hercules Hold, Yoke Race and pulling a real Viking ship are some of the ingredients of this fantastic show.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E02 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 2, Germany
programme.desc: The second stage of Strongman champions league will be hosted in Germany, by FIBO - the leading international trade show for fitness, wellness and health worldwide with 300,000 visitors in four days. Special implements like the biggest log in the world or the special Bavarian stone lift are not only a challenge, but also an opportunity for new personal, national and world records.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E03 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 3, Holland
programme.desc: Holland is hosting 12 different countries with 14 of the strongest men in the world for the third stage of the Strongman Champions League.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E04 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 4, Finland
programme.desc: Zydrunas Savickas, one of strongest people on earth is in this competition which has attracted the attention of the audience in the battle for the title of strongest man in Finland. The next round of SCL is in Bulgaria.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E05 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 5, Bulgaria
programme.desc: The next stage of the competition is in Bulgaria where Ervin Katona (SCL World Champion 2012) will compete for the last time.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E06 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 6, Latvia
programme.desc: Krzysztof Radzikowski, the leader in the league will fight hard to keep Dainis Zageris off from the title and to gather another 25 ranking points in this next stage in Latvia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E07 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 7, Croatia
programme.desc: The competition sees a close battle with a new world record in overhead dumbbell and close finishes throughout the day. This stage is in Croatia, in a city over 1700 years old, steeped in Roman tradition and history, the athletes arrive for the truck pull after a picturesque boat ride on the Adriatic Sea.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E08 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 8, Poland
programme.desc: We are now half way through the SCL 2015 and getting closer to the grand world finals in Turkey. The eighth stage is in Poland, the home country of the current leader Krzysztof Radzikowski.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E09 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 9, Austria
programme.desc: In this stage we go into the mountains of Austria to find out through six grueling events who is the strongest in the land of Alps. Martin Wildauer, current World Champion 2014 and Austrian local is competing alongside Zageris, Radzikowski, Belsak and many others.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E10 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 10, Romania
programme.desc: The 10th stage of this year's competition in Strongman Champions League is held in the Romanian city of Sibiu where the 12 strongmen continue to compete for the title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E11 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 11, World Log Lift Championship
programme.desc: The 11th stage is the SCL Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. In this championship, each competitor must lift three different weights overhead. Zydrunas Savickas is the current world record holder in the Log Lift.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E12 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 12, Lithuania
programme.desc: This next episode of the Strongman Champions League is hosted in Lithuania and sees us getting one step closer to the final.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S02 : E13 SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 13, Portugal
programme.desc: The 13th stage of Strongman Champions League is in Maia, Portugal. The competition is at the “Powerexpo” – one of the best sport and fitness events in Portugal.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In America
programme.desc: Het zou meer dan tien jaar duren voor Sergio Leone zijn epische gangstersaga over New York op het witte doek kon brengen.

programme.title: Guess Who
programme.desc: Percy Jones is de begrijpelijkerwijs trotse vader van Theresa, een mooie en intelligente jonge vrouw die in New York City woont. Als Percy erachter komt dat zijn dochter met iemand uitgaat en het serieus wordt, besluit hij wat onderzoek te doen...

programme.title: Dik Trom - De Vetste Film
programme.desc: Dik Trom is een vrolijke, eerlijke, maar vooral gezette jongen. Samen met zijn ouders woont hij in het knusse Dikkedam, waar iedereen net zo dik en uitbundig is als hij. Het is er elke dag feest.

programme.title: Sommersby
programme.desc: Men herinnert zich Jack Sommersby. Men kent hem als een verbitterde, ruwe man. Maar wanneer Jack na de Burgeroorlog terug naar huis komt is hijteder, liefdevol en vindingrijk.

programme.title: Shattered Glass
programme.desc: Als de gevierde journalist Stephen Glass onderzocht wordt door een reporter van Forbes wordt duidelijk dat Glass veel van zijn sensationele verhalen verzonnen heeft, wat tot zijn ondergang leidt in dit aangrijpende drama gebaseerd op feiten.

programme.title: Weg Van Jou
programme.desc: Romcom die draait om de stadse Evi (Herbers). Met frisse tegenzin wordt ze door haar werkgever van hip Rotterdam overgeplaatst naar stil Zeeuws-Vlaanderen. Dat het niet allemaal onverstaanbare Zeeuwen zijn, blijkt als Evi in Terneuzen de stoere visser Stijn (Heijmans) ontmoet.

programme.title: Good Deeds
programme.desc: Als hoofd van het familiebedrijf Deeds Corporation heeft Wesley (Tyler Perry) altijd gedaan wat er van hem verwacht wordt, maar als hij een alleenstaande moeder met problemen ontmoet, gaat hij het leven leiden dat hij altijd gewild heeft.

programme.title: Thick as Thieves
programme.desc: Twee meesterdieven raken in conflict wanneer de één de ander erin luist. Alec Baldwin speelt de charmante professional, Michael Jai White de gangster. Hun strijd trekt een maffiabaas en een agente mee in een explosieve confrontatie.

programme.title: Hereditary
programme.desc: Nadat de grootmoeder van de familie Graham overlijdt, werpt de aanwezigheid van deze weinig geliefde vrouw nog steeds een schaduw op het gezin.

programme.title: Jackie
programme.desc: De 33-jarige tweeling Sofie en Daan is opgevoed door twee vaders. Wanneer er totaal onverwacht een telefoontje van hun, tot dan toe onbekende, biologische moeder uit Amerika komt, storten ze zich in een avontuur waardoor alle aannames die ze hadden op losse schroeven komen te staan.

programme.title: Undisputed 4
programme.desc: In het vierde deel van deze bikkelharde actiefilm franchise, beproeft Boyka (Scott Adkins) zijn geluk in de professionele Europese competitie. Wanneer een van zijn tegenstanders het gevecht met de dood moet bekopen, beseft Boyka dat hij niet alleen voor de titel maar ook voor zijn leven vecht.

programme.title: Willy's Wonderland
programme.desc: Een rondreizende man (Nicolas Cage) wordt misleid tot het aannemen van een baantje als conciërge in het verlaten pretpark Willy’s Wonderland...

programme.title: I Saw the Devil
programme.desc: Kyung-chul is een gevaarlijke seriemoordenaar die de politie al lange tijd op het spoor is. De wereld zoals we die ooit kenden bestaat niet meer: hordes zielloze vampiers hebben de menselijke beschaving zo goed als uitgeroeid.

programme.title: Date Movie
programme.desc: Julia Jones weet eindelijk de man van haar dromen aan de haak weet te slaan, maar nu wordt haar perfecte bruiloft bedreigd door haar ex, een schetenlatende kat en excentrieke schoonfamilie.

programme.title: Fantastic Mr. Fox
programme.desc: Samen met mevrouw Fox, zoon Ash, neefje Kristofferson en al hun vrienden beleeft meneer Fox een avontuur om zijn familie te beschermen. Een grappig en betoverend verhaal voor het hele gezin!

programme.title: Meet Dave
programme.desc: Een groep kleine mensachtige buitenaardse wezens arriveert op aarde in een ruimteschip dat erg veel lijkt op hun eigen kapitein. De besturing van het ruimteschip levert in de omgang met mensen nogal wat misverstanden op…

programme.title: Guess Who
programme.desc: Percy Jones is de begrijpelijkerwijs trotse vader van Theresa, een mooie en intelligente jonge vrouw die in New York City woont. Als Percy erachter komt dat zijn dochter met iemand uitgaat en het serieus wordt, besluit hij wat onderzoek te doen...

programme.title: Single Moms Club
programme.desc: Een groep alleenstaande moeders van verschillende afkomst komt samen om een praatgroep op te richten waar ze hun problemen kunnen bespreken, de humor in hun tegenslagen kunnen vinden en hun innerlijke kracht kunnen aanboren om hun persoonlijke uitdagingen te overwinnen.

programme.title: Weg Van Jou
programme.desc: Romcom die draait om de stadse Evi (Herbers). Met frisse tegenzin wordt ze door haar werkgever van hip Rotterdam overgeplaatst naar stil Zeeuws-Vlaanderen. Dat het niet allemaal onverstaanbare Zeeuwen zijn, blijkt als Evi in Terneuzen de stoere visser Stijn (Heijmans) ontmoet.

programme.title: Before We Go
programme.desc: New York City. Een jonge vrouw (Alice Eve) haast zich om de trein van 1.30 uur naar Boston te halen. Onderweg wordt ze overvallen en lijkt ze er helemaal alleen voor te staan. Vervolgens ontmoet ze een man (Chris Evans) waarmee ze in de loop van de nacht een onwaarschijnlijke band opbouwt.

programme.title: Bedazzled
programme.desc: De naïeve computertechnicus Elliot wordt het slachtoffer van een sexy duivelin. Hij verkoopt zijn ziel in ruil voor zeven wensen, in de hoop dat zijn mooie collega verliefd op hem wordt.

programme.title: Fantastic Mr. Fox
programme.desc: Samen met mevrouw Fox, zoon Ash, neefje Kristofferson en al hun vrienden beleeft meneer Fox een avontuur om zijn familie te beschermen. Een grappig en betoverend verhaal voor het hele gezin!

programme.title: Seized
programme.desc: De zoon van een voormalig geheim agent wordt ontvoerd en hij moet nu drie gevaarlijke misdaadorganisaties uitschakelen als hij zijn zoon ooit nog levend terug wilt zien.

programme.title: Blue Velvet
programme.desc: In een ogenschijnlijk sereen dorp sluimert de duisternis waar onschuldigen zich niet wagen en alles onvoorspelbaar is. Kyle MacLachlan, Isabella Rossellini, Dennis Hopper & Laura Dern spelen in David Lynchs meesterwerk vol mysterie en gekte.

programme.title: Willy's Wonderland
programme.desc: Een rondreizende man (Nicolas Cage) wordt misleid tot het aannemen van een baantje als conciërge in het verlaten pretpark Willy’s Wonderland...

programme.title: Homefront
programme.desc: Voormalig narcotica-agent Phil Broker denkt een rustiger leven te krijgen nu hij zich met zijn dochtertje in een plattelandsstadje heeft gevestigd. Het Amerikaanse zuiden blijkt echter nogal licht ontvlambaar.

programme.title: Loosies
programme.desc: Bobby, een zakkenroller uit New York, wordt geconfronteerd door een vrouw waar hij een onenightstand mee heeft gehad. Wanneer Lucy hem vertelt dat ze zwanger is, moet hij de realiteit onder ogen zien. Plotseling botsen twee verschillende werelden, waardoor Bobby zijn leven opnieuw moet evalueren.

programme.title: The Hustle
programme.desc: Josephine Chesterfield (Anne Hathaway) is een glamoureuze, verleidelijke Brit met een voorliefde voor het bedriegen van goedgelovige rijke mannen. In haar goed geordende wereld barst Penny Rust (Rebel Wilson), een Australiër die net zo vrij van vorm en plezier is als Josephine berekend en sluw is.

programme.title: Harvey's laatste kans (Last Chance Harvey)
programme.desc: Een ploeterende New Yorkse jingleschrijver (Dustin Hoffman) en een eenzame Britse bureaucraat (Emma Thompson) ontmoeten elkaar bij toeval in Londen en geven een nieuwe draai aan elkaars leven.

programme.title: Weg Van Jou
programme.desc: Romcom die draait om de stadse Evi (Herbers). Met frisse tegenzin wordt ze door haar werkgever van hip Rotterdam overgeplaatst naar stil Zeeuws-Vlaanderen. Dat het niet allemaal onverstaanbare Zeeuwen zijn, blijkt als Evi in Terneuzen de stoere visser Stijn (Heijmans) ontmoet.

programme.title: Jackie
programme.desc: De 33-jarige tweeling Sofie en Daan is opgevoed door twee vaders. Wanneer er totaal onverwacht een telefoontje van hun, tot dan toe onbekende, biologische moeder uit Amerika komt, storten ze zich in een avontuur waardoor alle aannames die ze hadden op losse schroeven komen te staan.

programme.title: Shattered Glass
programme.desc: Als de gevierde journalist Stephen Glass onderzocht wordt door een reporter van Forbes wordt duidelijk dat Glass veel van zijn sensationele verhalen verzonnen heeft, wat tot zijn ondergang leidt in dit aangrijpende drama gebaseerd op feiten.

programme.title: Good Deeds
programme.desc: Als hoofd van het familiebedrijf Deeds Corporation heeft Wesley (Tyler Perry) altijd gedaan wat er van hem verwacht wordt, maar als hij een alleenstaande moeder met problemen ontmoet, gaat hij het leven leiden dat hij altijd gewild heeft.

programme.title: Before We Go
programme.desc: New York City. Een jonge vrouw (Alice Eve) haast zich om de trein van 1.30 uur naar Boston te halen. Onderweg wordt ze overvallen en lijkt ze er helemaal alleen voor te staan. Vervolgens ontmoet ze een man (Chris Evans) waarmee ze in de loop van de nacht een onwaarschijnlijke band opbouwt.

programme.title: Wild Mountain Thyme
programme.desc: Al haar hele leven is de koppige Rosemary verliefd op haar verlegen buurman Anthony. Hij weet zich echter geen raad met haar gevoelens. Daarbij heeft hij zijn handen vol aan zijn eigenwijze vader Tony, die hun boerderij wil verkopen aan zijn succesvolle Amerikaanse neef Adam.

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: Wanneer een bijdehante zwarte oplichter uit Zuid-Centraal LA wordt teruggevoerd naar het middeleeuwse Engeland, leidt hij de omverwerping van een kwaadaardige koning en wint hij het hart van een protofeministische vrouw.

programme.title: Black Gold
programme.desc: Arabië in de jaren 30. De tijd van een ontdekking die de hele wereld zal veranderen; het zwarte goud, olie. De jonge Arabische prins Auda (Tahar Rahim) die getrouwd is met de beeldschone Leyla (Freida Pinto) raakt verwikkeld in een strijd tussen twee rivaliserende Emirs...

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: Nadat IP Man (Donnie Yen) in de tweede Chinees Japanse oorlog zijn vechtkunsten tegen de Japanners inzette, vluchtte hij in 1949 naar Hongkong en probeerde daar een Wing Chun vechtschool op te richten. Als de machtige meester Hung dat hoort, stelt hij IP Man voor een opgave.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.desc: Hannah in her final leg of her backpacking journey in Indonesia, explores the island’s beautiful temples and wraps up her day with a traditional dinner. Next morning she visits the turtle island where learns about its conservation and tries parasailing. Her trip concludes with an unforgettable experience of undersea walking.

programme.title: Xplore Bulgaria
programme.desc: Like Rome, Plovdiv straddles seven hills; but as Europe’s oldest continuously inhabited city, it’s far more ancient. As Catriona takes a tour of the city to see its iconic attractions such as a Roman Amphitheatre, which was once the setting for gladiator fights, and the striking Baroque Saints Constantine and Helena Church, she begins to see how seamlessly modern life blends with the age-old ruins. Along the way, she realizes why Plovdiv is called the ‘Eternal City’ of Bulgaria.

programme.title: Xp guide
programme.desc: The clear blue sea, the white sparkling sands and the sun kissing your skin, Mauritius is what dreams are made of.

programme.title: City Breaks
programme.desc: The architecture of Budapest has gained it the nickname, “The Paris of the East”. Catriona loses herself, here, in the quaint vibe of classic buildings such as the St. Matthias Church and the Royal Palace. After soaking in the romance of a Danube river cruise, she soaks in one of the thermal baths for which the city is known. She also tries the infamous paprika that fires up the flavours of Hungarian cuisine.

programme.title: Unplanned Trip
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Unplanned Trip Jairampur, India
programme.desc: Roshni’s journey gets off to a rocky start, when she encounters a flat tyre on her way to Jairampur. To add to her disappointment, she realizes that she is in the town on the one day when everything around is shut. When she sets out to explore the attractions in the vicinity, however, she chances upon a World War II cemetery, which narrates riveting stories about the famous Stilwell Road. Suddenly, her day picks up.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.desc: Sommer visits Gir forest, last reserve for Asiatic lions in the world. Later travels to Kutch and experience its vibrant cultural fiesta, “Rann Utsav.

programme.title: 10 Days Cyprus
programme.desc: Larnaca in Cyprus is one of the world’s 20 most ancient, continuously inhabited cities for the last 4000 years. Travel enthusiast, Sabrina sets out to find out more about the city but is waylaid when she finds a flock of flamingos at a lake side.

programme.title: Xplore Bulgaria
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Xplore Bulgaria Sunny Beach
programme.desc: Luxurious hotels, thrilling water parks, inexpensive food and almost 300 days of bright sunny weather make Bulgaria’s biggest seaside resort, Sunny Beach popular for budget beach getaways. Catriona, however, stumbles onto the historic town of Nessebar, which is over 3000 years old, and realizes that there is more to the place than meets the eye. She goes on to visit the Castra Rubra winery, where she finds out about the history of Viticulture in Bulgaria and the process of wine making.

programme.title: Xp guide
programme.desc: A slice of paradise, poised on turquoise ocean, lapped by its warm waters enchants you and beckons you to explore its mysteriously beautiful spirit.

programme.title: City Breaks
programme.desc: On a short break in Belfast, the capital of Northern Ireland, Olivia, an avid traveller, finds herself infected by the energy of the city at a traditional Victorian market. At the city’s main attractions like Belfast City Hall and Belfast Castle, she gets to know its history. She also visits the Ulster Museum, which tells her stories about the Egyptians in Ireland, and Titanic Belfast, which makes the grand ship and its downfall come alive for her.

programme.title: Unplanned Trip
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Unplanned Trip Namsai, India
programme.desc: Roshni visits a land of lush green paddy fields and gentle rivers, of traditional bamboo houses and Buddhist temples – Namsai in Arunachal Pradesh. The highlight of this idyllic town, the Golden Pagoda, leaves her spellbound. Here, she spends a day with the monks and finds out the secret behind the peaceful lives they lead.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.desc: Jaisalmer, has a skyline dominated by majestic 'Sonar Quila'. Explore with our host as she takes you through the rustic charm of this fort city.

programme.title: 10 Days Cyprus
programme.desc: Nicosia, the capital of the Republic of Cyprus is also its cultural heartbeat. Sabrina realizes this, as she sets out to unravel the stories of the largest city in Cyprus while being treated to a bath in a Hammam, which was formerly a church.

programme.title: Xplore Bulgaria
programme.desc: For the people of Sofia, preserving its heritage is sacrosanct, and this can be seen in the way the city's infrastructure is built around its archeological treasures. Catriona realizes this when she roams around the cobblestone streets of the city. With every monument she visits, she finds herself transported to a different era, right from Perperikon fort, which narrate stories of the Byzantine empire, to Boyana church, which is home to some of the earliest examples of medieval artwork.

programme.title: Xp guide
programme.desc: Our finale in Mauritius, explore a country filled with fun, frolic, blue oceans, sugar cane fields, adventure, and lots of more unique experiences.

programme.title: City Breaks
programme.desc: In a 48-hour escape from boardrooms and deadlines, Sukriti finds herself in the enchanting city of pearls: Hyderabad.

programme.title: Backpack
programme.sub-title: S01 : E15 Backpack Jodhpur and Nimaj, India
programme.desc: Our host continues backpacking on her way to Jodhpur, she visits a temple where motorcycle is worshiped. Later explores Mehrangarh fort via zip line.

She further ventures out to explore the Neolithic village of Khirokitia and learn about the age-old lace tradition in Lefkara village.

programme.title: Xplore
programme.desc: When you visit the glorious land of the Pharaohs, the first thing on your to-do list should be, visiting the tombs of mummies and paying a tribute.

programme.title: Xplore
programme.desc: We continue to explore Aswan with the eyes of the local inhabitants of the country, soaking in the Nile seascape and enjoying a horse carriage ride to the picturesque and intriguing temple of Edfu.

programme.title: City Breaks

She also encounters the city’s strong Catholic roots at Cathedral de Valencia, the alleged home of the Holy Grail used by Christ at the Last Supper.

programme.title: Backpack

Next, he visits Squamish lil’wat cultural center to learn about the Aboriginal people. Finally, he takes a tour of Pemberton valley on a horse, tries Canada’s highest zipline and bungee jumps over the Cheakamus river.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Leo continues his story about how Zarc destroyed the original world. Leo's daughter Ray used four cards to stop Zarc and split the world into the four current worlds. He then reveals the true nature of Yuya, Yuzu, and the Arc Area Project.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Leo begins his final plan to fuse the dimensions and revive his daughter Ray. Reiji and Yuya team up to take down Leo, with Yuya resolving not to let Zarc be revived. Yusho realizes that even this is part of a larger enemy's plan.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Leo's plan gets further and further to completion, which causes the evil inside of Yuya to emerge once more. Yusho stops the duel and realizes that Zarc's influence is hovering over everything, including Yuya's other counterparts.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yugo and Yuri being their duel, with Zarc's shared influence forcing them into battle. To stop Zarc's revival, Kaito and Edo join the battle as well to hold back Yuri's powerful Fusion Dragon.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: While Yuri and Yugo continue their savage battle, Reira starts hearing the voice of Ray. Aiming to make sure Ray is revived, Reira stands against Reiji and the siblings begin a duel with each other.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Reiji manages to defeat Reira, continuing on to fight Leo. Elsewhere, Yuri absorbs Yugo and aims to defeat Yuya so that Zarc can be completed. Yusho stands in for his son to fight the depraved youth instead.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Reiji manages to defeat Reira, continuing on to fight Leo. Elsewhere, Yuri absorbs Yugo and aims to defeat Yuya so that Zarc can be completed. Yusho stands in for his son to fight the depraved youth instead.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yusho's advanced Dueltaining manages to push Yuri into a corner and bring Yuya back to his old self. But Yuri is determined to complete Zarc's revival and has one nasty surprise in store for Yusho.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Seeing his father carded in front of his eyes, Yuya's rage reaches a boiling point as he accepts Yuri's challenge. But not only does he have to contend with Yugo and Yuri's dragons, but Zarc's ever growing influence over him.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The four dimensions start to fuse together as Yuya continues to struggle against Yuri. Forced to discard his trump card, things seem hopeless. Yuya's friends then arrive to encourage him to keep fighting no matter what.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.sub-title: S03 : E136 A Most Brutal Duel
programme.desc: Yuya absorbs all of his counterparts and reclaimed his true form as Supreme King Z-ARC. Starting to lay waste to the Fusion Dimension, Sora and Edo challenge Zarc to try and reach out to Yuya's spirit.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The four dimensions continue to unite as Zarc effortlessly crushes Sora and Edo. Kaito and Shun continue the fight against Zarc while people from Heartland and Neo Domino City start appearing in the Fusion Dimension.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Gongenzaka and Jack fight against Zarc next, trying their best to reach out to Yuya's soul buried in Zarc's darkness. A revived Crow and Sawatari decide to join in when Zarc's Supreme King Dragons swarm the field.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Crow notices that Zarc is starting to lose his composure, leading him and Sawatari to up their game against Zarc's dragons. As dimensional integration is getting closer to completion, Reiji tries to convince his dad to stop Zarc.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.sub-title: S03 : E140 A Ray of Hope
programme.desc: Ray's soul possesses Reira so she can battle against Zarc alongside Reiji. Zarc boasts that he is the creator of Pendulum Summon, but Ray is determined to stop him once and for all using the four natural energy cards.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.sub-title: S03 : E141 Swinging Back into Action
programme.desc: Things have seemingly returned to normal in the Pendulum Dimension, but Yuya gets the feeling that something is missing. Reiji has him duel against Tsukikage to restore his memories and make him finish the Lancer's goal for good.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The battle royale continues. As Yuya keeps fighting, his memories start flooding back to him. Yuzu's dad suddenly remembers too as the rest of the world slowly begins to remember the Lancers and the battle against Zarc.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Reiji reveals that Zarc is still alive and Reira is barely holding back his malevolence. The world must be united and Yuya must purge Zarc's evil once and for all. Yuya is unsure. but Gongenzaka attempts to ignite his fighting spirit.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya arrives in the Xyz Dimensions with Dennis as his next opponent. Threatening to turn the traumatized citizens of Heartland into cards again, Dennis forces Yuya into a duel against him and his Xyz/Fusion mix.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya arrives in the Fusion Dimension where he finds a distraught Shun. Like with Yuya's counterparts, Ruri and the others have not been resurrected following Ray's revival. Yuya tries to calm Shun down only to end up the target of his fury.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.sub-title: S03 : E146 One Way Street to Defeat
programme.desc: Jack appears to taunt Yuya over his fear of using his counterpart's dragons in fear of summoning Zarc. Unable to accomplish anything as is, Yuya challenges Jack to a duel while Reiji makes it so everyone can watch the battle.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya finally listens to his other selves and summons all four of his dragons to defeat Jack. However, there is one final challenge before him in order to become a Dueltainer and purge Zarc: his rival and friend Reiji Akaba.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The curtain is about to fall for the last time. The final battle between Yuya and Reiji rages on. Dragons face off against D/D/D as the whole world watches. What will be the final fate of Yuya, Yuzu, and all four dueling dimensions?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Go With the Flow - Part 1
programme.desc: In Heartland, Yuma Tsukumo aspires to be the world's best Duelist. Despite this, he is not a good Duelist. When he ends up Dueling, Shark, a student known to have pro-level skills, odd things begin to happen and Yuma's story begins.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Go With the Flow - Part 2
programme.desc: The Duel between Yuma and Ryoga comes to its conclusion. In order to take down "Leviathan Dragon", Yuma obtains a "Number" monster of his own, "Utopia".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 In the End - Part 1
programme.desc: Astral's been unable to leave since Yuma Dueled Shark, so, despite his reluctance, he's begun living with Yuma. At an inconvenient time, Akari Tsukumo has trouble when her PC she uses as a stay-at-home reporter crashes. When her big scoop is deleted as a result of a system down the city suffered, she orders Yuma to find an alternate scoop she can use for another manuscript. When Yuma goes into town, the traffic lights go nuts, causing downtown to fall into chaos. Yuma looks for the criminal who spread the computer virus that caused all this chaos.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 In the End - Part 2
programme.desc: Yuma challenges Professor Kitano, who is behind it all. Professor Kitano notes that each time he reduces his opponent's Life Points with "Electronic Computer-Beast Tera Byte" Astral's body weakens, causing him to slowly vanish! To make things worse, the Explosive Virus Time Bomb Ukyo has set is slowly reaching its countdown.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: A strange shadow approaches Yuma, which turns out to be Tokunosuke Omoteura, a classmate of Yuma's known for his duplicitous tongue. In the morning, Yuma was reprimanded for a prank he pulled in front of the whole class that he has no memory of causing. As a result, he's been cut off from every one else. Tokunosuke gently says "Let's Duel". With "Baby Tragon" his new Xyz Monster, Yuma might enjoy this duel, but Tokunosuke seems to be planning something.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Tokunosuke steals Yuma's "Utopia", causing Astral to vanish. Tokunosuke wanted the great power of Numbers, and Yuma tries to Summon "Leviathan Dragon" to fight back, but Tokunosuke's Trap Card takes even that away. When Yuma is pushed into a corner with his field, an unexpected monster will become the Trump Card of the Duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: After having been around a while and having to work with Yuma, Astral's been fascinated by a TV Show Hero named "Different Dimension ESPer Robin". For some reason, Astral feels close and similar to this Robin from an alternate universe. One day, pictures show up with Robin in a fight downtown! Yuma, prodded by Astral, goes with Kotori to where the autographs were taken and meets Robin's actor, a kid named Fuya! But Fuya is a timid boy who doesn't resemble the Robin they all admire in the slightest.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: The mysterious person posing as Robin around town was Fuya. Under the intolerable strain of being a hero, Fuya's heart has been overcome by darkness Yuma challenges him to a Duel to save his soul. Robin, however, possesses "Number 83: Galaxy Queen". With it, he proceeds to summon one character after another from the TV Show. At first, Yuma and Astral were amused by this, but due to Galaxy Queen's almighty Monster Effect, they quickly grow impatient. To make things worse, Galaxy Queen, who currently possesses Robin, has taken on the appearance of Fuya's mother.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: A suspicious shadow is trailing Yuma. It seems someone has been after Yuma, and their identity is the unassuming girl Cat-chan from Yuma's class. Yuma and Kotori fall into Cat-chan's trap. To rescue Kotori, he's going to have to Duel. Astral is cautious of the strange vibes he's getting from Cat-chan, especially with the strategy of her "Transforming Cat Deck"!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma is reminded that his victories in his current Duels are due to Astral's help. To prove his skills, he fights Shark once more. Though Shark doesn't care to Duel again, he finally agrees when he finally reaches the end of his rope due to Yuma's constant following him around. The Duel of these two begins. Can Yuma win against Shark, who has no "Number" cards, when he himself declares he won't use his "Number" cards or take the aid of Astral!?After his Duel with Shark, Yuma Duels Tetsuo Takeda without "Numbers" and loses twenty times in a row, with Tetsuo angry because Yuma lied about not using the "Numbers" against Shark. Yuma is scolded by Astral on his immaturity. On the other hand,...

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: After his Duel with Shark, Yuma Duels Tetsuo Takeda without "Numbers" and loses twenty times in a row, with Tetsuo angry because Yuma lied about not using the "Numbers" against Shark. Yuma is scolded by Astral on his immaturity. On the other hand, Shark returns to "his place" where he gets involved with a criminal network. Yuma, who knew what was going on with Shark, challenges the two strongest thugs: Rikuo and Kaio, to what Shark proposes to be a 2 on 2 "Tag-Team Duel".

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Yuma finds himself pinned down by the overwhelming power of "Number 61: Volcasaurus". To protect their precious remaining Life Points, he defends Shark at his own expense. When their opponents summon their second Number monster at that point, Astral becomes aware of the hidden mysteries underlying the Duel. In a last-ditch effort, Shark notices Yuma's passion and entrusts him with 1 card that could turn the whole Duel around!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.sub-title: S01 : E13 The Number Hunter - Part 1
programme.desc: After a series of incidents, Yuma and Astral learn of the existence of a "Number Hunter". Astral remains wary of an unseen presence, but Yuma pretends not to care. As a result, a series of strange phenomena appear around these two. Undeniably, these are the signs of the coming of the "Number Hunter" named Kaito Tenjo. At that moment, a dangerous Duel with the Numbers cards on the line begins. With Kaito's power far beyond their reckoning, what can Astral or Yuma possibly do?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.sub-title: S01 : E14 The Number Hunter - Part 2
programme.desc: In just 1 Turn, Kaito Summons 2 Numbers. Yuma attempts to resist the onslaught, but all of his monsters have been removed from the field...! Kaito, capable of even more, summons the strongest Monster to exist: "Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon", which has never been seen before! Yuma summons "Number 39: Utopia" to create a turnaround despite the impossible odds facing him.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: Having clearly seen Kaito's power, and how utterly hopeless they are, Yuma and Astral are keenly aware that they cannot easily recover. At that time, Yuma talks to his grandmother. She mentions a mysterious old man named Jurou at a "Duel Lodge" who owns a wooden statue of the Legendary Monster "Dark Magician", who is waiting for Yuma and his crew. Yuma makes a strong wish based on his desire to train and get better!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: It's a Duel against Jurou's former disciple, Yamikawa! Yamikawa draws his Ninja monsters, pinning Yuma down, but believing in the power of his friends, Yuma must continue this battle to the Death! But, Yamikawa summons his Trump Card, the Number Monster "Armed Ninja - Crimson Shadow"! However, Yuma continues to believe in the power of his friends, but can this possibly lead him to win the Duel!?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.sub-title: S01 : E17 It's in the Cards - Part 1
programme.desc: Kotori and her friends, who are interested in the Number cards, plus Astral, form the "Number Club". To get more info about the Numbers, they visit the home of a fortuneteller, but the fortuneteller is under the orders of Kaito to collect the Number Cards! When the fortuneteller, Jin, kidnaps Kotori and the rest, Yuma and Astral come to the rescue, but the memory of their Duel with Kaito comes back, the visions of which continue to haunt them!

In the midst of such a terrible pinch, Astral finds himself scared by Kaito's looming shadow, but when he sees Yuma who refuses to give up, he steps back up to the fight. With the feelings of these two guys, "Utopia" obtains a new power!

Yuma's Never-Give-Up Spirit "Kattobingu" was born from a promise he made with his father.

Not having reconciled in over 2 days, suddenly Number 96 swallows Yuma and Astral up!! To rescue Yuma and Astral from Number 96, Tetsuo fights the Numbers for the first time!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL
programme.desc: In order to protect Yuma's Key from Kite, Shark faces him in a Duel.

programme.sub-title: S01 : E23 Hunting Down the Hunter - Part 1

At that time, Kite, using Dr. Faker's technology, retraces Astral's memories and invites Yuma to the World Duel Carnival.

programme.title: King of Hearts
programme.sub-title: S02 : E100 King of Hearts S2 E100
programme.desc: Jamai Raja is an Indian drama series about Siddharth, who marries Roshni to mend her strained relationship with her mother, Durga Devi Patel. The show explores the complexities of family dynamics, love, and duty as Siddharth navigates various challenges to unite his new family.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.sub-title: S03 : E45 Jodha Akbar S3 E45
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.sub-title: S01 : E56 A King and His Queen S1 E56
programme.desc: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land!

programme.title: Jodha Akbar

Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.sub-title: S03 : E49 Jodha Akbar S3 E49
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.
